title: Instructions for Form 4562 (2025), Depreciation and Amortization

passages.question: What special depreciation allowance applies to the excavator, the crew 3 truck and the tablets acquired in 2025?
passages.excerpt: P.L. 119-21, commonly known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, reinstated the 100% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired and placed in service after January 19, 2025 ... However, you can elect to take a 40% special depreciation allowance ... during first tax year ending after January 19, 2025, instead of taking the 100% special depreciation allowance.
